data.title: 守岸人 · 黑海岸潮汐的白色花嫁
data.description: 守岸人穿着不透的白色长裙婚纱站在灯塔花园，蓝色头纱像潮汐一样落在肩头；她用双手护住一束小小的海滨花，紫色眼睛第一次因“被等待”而露出明显的温柔。
data.action: 灯塔花园双手护住海滨花束，感受到被等待后紫瞳显出温柔
data.lighting: lavender dusk with a warm lighthouse rim
data.camera: cowboy shot, bouquet and lighthouse garden visible
data.promptProse: She protects her coastal bouquet with both hands in the lighthouse garden, warm light outlining her veil against the lavender sky.
data.animaCaption: Both hands protect the coastal bouquet while warm lighthouse light outlines her veil.
